body_text:
For any indexed family $(A_i)_{i\in I}$, $x\in\bigcup_{i\in I}A_i$
exactly when $x\in A_i$ for at least one $i\in I$, while
$x\in\bigcap_{i\in I}A_i$ exactly when $x\in A_i$ for every
$i\in I$. If $I$ is empty, the union is $\emptyset$; the empty
intersection is meaningful only relative to a specified ambient
universe, where it equals that universe.
